segments.title: 第179章 又是洗手
segments.content:
Rekindling the Verdant Years Chapter 179: Washing Hands Again

Hearing the sound of Ying Chanxi coming in, Li Luo, with the hand speed of a man single for decades, closed the word processor and the chat window with his editor, then turned around as if nothing had happened.

"Celebrating New Year's Eve? We could definitely do that."

With this thought, Li Luo got up and walked outside, passing Ying Chanxi to arrive at Xu Youyu's door.

Seeing that he was about to knock, Ying Chanxi's face flushed with a little panic, and she hurriedly tried to stop him, "Wait..."

But she was half a beat too slow.

Li Luo had already knocked on Xu Youyu's door and called inside, "Senior, want to come out and celebrate New Year's Eve together?"

"Hm?" Xu Youyu pushed the door open, poked her head out to look at Li Luo, then asked with a bewildered expression, "Where's Chanxi?"

"She's joining too."

"But before she took a shower just now, she told me she was planning to go straight to sleep." Xu Youyu scratched her head, a bit confused about the situation. "I was already in bed getting ready to sleep."

After they both finished speaking, they turned their heads in unison to look at Ying Chanxi.

Ying Chanxi waved her hands in a fluster, quickly explaining, "I-I was a little sleepy before, but after my shower, I felt energized again, so I thought it would be more fun to celebrate New Year's Eve together."

Li Luo and Xu Youyu didn't think much of it. After nodding in understanding, Xu Youyu came out of her bedroom.

The three of them went to the living room and began their discussion.

"So how should we celebrate?" Li Luo asked. "Want me to cook something?"

"We're out of groceries, right?" Xu Youyu said. "There's nothing much left in the fridge. Why don't we just go downstairs and buy some snacks? The supermarket should still be open."

"We could buy some fireworks," Ying Chanxi muttered in a low voice.

"Do they sell fireworks at the supermarket?" Li Luo asked curiously.

"They do," Ying Chanxi immediately nodded, looking like she knew all about it.

Fireworks didn't usually sell well, so most supermarkets only stocked them during the Spring Festival.

Li Luo wasn't really sure if they would have any during New Year's Day.

But since Ying Chanxi said they did, he would put it on the list for now.

"And then?" Li Luo asked. "As for fireworks, we can wait until midnight to go downstairs and play with them, but it's only ten o'clock now, still a while before midnight."

"Let's play cards," Xu Youyu suggested. "We can also buy a couple of decks of poker. We'll eat snacks, watch TV, and play Fight the Landlord at the same time."

Li Luo looked at Ying Chanxi, and seeing that she had no objections, he nodded in confirmation. "Then we'll buy snacks, fireworks, and poker."

"OK, let's go!"

Getting up from the sofa, Li Luo went straight to his room to grab a down jacket and pull on a pair of pants, ready to go downstairs.

But when Li Luo came out of his bedroom, he saw the two on the sofa, still in their pajamas, already watching TV, and was momentarily lost in thought.

"What's the meaning of this, you two?"

"Junior, it's time to show off your charm as a man." Xu Youyu gave him a thumbs-up. "It's only two or three degrees outside today. Chanxi and I have already showered and changed into our pajamas. It'd be too much trouble to change again. Do you have the heart to let us go out and freeze?"

"You can do it." Ying Chanxi cheered Li Luo on, then took out three hundred-yuan bills from her pajama pocket and stuffed them into Li Luo's hand. "Take this. The rest is for your travel expenses and a tip."

Li Luo: "..."

Tsking, Li Luo shoved the cash in his hand forcefully into his pants pocket and turned to change his shoes at the door.

But just as he opened the door, he heard Ying Chanxi's voice from behind him again.

"Don't be in such a hurry to leave." Ying Chanxi trotted up behind him, pulled him around, and draped the red scarf around his neck. "This way you won't be cold."

"So I should thank you for that?"

"You're welcome." Ying Chanxi patted his shoulder. "Go on, remember to buy me potato chips, I want..."

"Barbecue and cucumber flavor, I know."

"Me too!" Xu Youyu shouted from the sofa. "I want that..."

"Original flavor, I know." Li Luo waved his hand and walked out the door. "I'll just call you guys later. You can order what you want to eat on the spot."

Even without their past life together, just these few months of living under the same roof were enough for Li Luo to have a clear grasp of their preferences for various dishes and snacks.

After leaving the apartment, a cold wind from the hallway window blew past, and Li Luo tightened the scarf around his neck.

It was a good thing he had the scarf; otherwise, the biting wind at this time of night would be quite harsh.

Taking the elevator all the way down to the first floor, Li Luo walked out of the residential complex and arrived at the supermarket outside. He took out his phone to call Ying Chanxi, then transformed into a procurement specialist.

After buying a full two large bags of snacks and fireworks, plus two boxes of playing cards, Li Luo paid, and it was only a little over a hundred yuan.

Back in 2014, money still went quite far; you could buy so much for just over a hundred.

Li Luo estimated that ten or twenty years in the future, these two big bags would cost at least two or three hundred.

With that thought, Li Luo walked out of the supermarket carrying the bags. He turned his head and noticed the fruit shop next door was still open, so he went in and bought some fruit.

By the time he got home, his palms were aching from the plastic bag handles and were already frozen cold.

At this point, the two women on the sofa had walked over to Li Luo's side.

Xu Youyu took the bags and carried them to the coffee table.

Ying Chanxi, on the other hand, pulled Li Luo all the way to the bathroom.

"What are you doing?" Li Luo was pulled into the bathroom in a daze, not quite understanding her actions.

But soon, Ying Chanxi took Li Luo's hands and submerged them in the hot water she had already prepared.

"Hiss... phew..."

The temperature of the water was just right, slightly scalding, but upon contact with Li Luo's ice-cold hands, he quickly got used to it. A comforting sensation followed, and his whole body subconsciously trembled a couple of times. His palms, which had been a bit cold, warmed up in an instant.

When he pulled his hands out, he could still feel the tingling numbness from the sudden change in temperature.

The next second, Ying Chanxi placed her own towel over Li Luo's hands and helped him dry them. "Is that better?"

"Yeah." Li Luo nodded and walked out of the bathroom with Ying Chanxi.

Xu Youyu was already blissfully munching on her original-flavored potato chips.

Li Luo snatched the bag right out of her hands, grabbed a handful, and stuffed them into his mouth.

"Hey, hey, hey!" Xu Youyu immediately became anxious, grabbing this rascal's arm and pulling it down. "There are so many snacks, why are you fighting with me for mine! Let go!"

"I bought you three bags of original flavor, isn't that enough for you?"

"That won't do either. This bag of chips has its own luck. Eating it will help me win at cards later." Xu Youyu snatched the chips back and hugged them to her chest. "You've taken a share of my luck."

"What kind of twisted logic is that?" Li Luo reached out for the playing cards he had bought, tore open the packaging, shuffled the cards, then pulled the coffee table closer to the sofa and tapped on it. "Come on, come on, stop dawdling. Let's start."

"Wait a minute!" Xu Youyu jumped up from the sofa and scurried into her bedroom.

A moment later, Li Luo and Ying Chanxi heard the sound of a heavy object being scraped and dragged across the floor.

Li Luo got up and walked to Xu Youyu's bedroom door to take a look, and was immediately speechless. "Where did you get a whole case of beer?"

"This is my treasured collection."

Xu Youyu dragged the beer case all the way to the side of the sofa, pulled out a can, and opened it. She then took a big swig. "Ahh, so refreshing. As expected, you need beer to go with playing cards and eating snacks."

"Senior, is it really okay to drink alcohol?" Ying Chanxi said quietly.

"What does it matter? We're not at school." Xu Youyu waved her hand dismissively and pulled out two more cans of beer from the case. "Want one, you two?"

Ying Chanxi instinctively shook her head.

But when she saw Li Luo, despite his helpless expression, reach out and take a can, she immediately stopped shaking her head. Hesitantly, she reached out for the can of beer.

"I'll just try a little."

"Just take a sip. If you don't like it, don't drink it," Li Luo reminded her. "I bought soft drinks over there."

"Oh." Ying Chanxi nodded, then watched as Li Luo popped the tab on his beer can, tilted his head back, and took a swig. She grew a little suspicious. "Li Luo, have you secretly had beer before?"

"Er... how could I... I'm a good student."

"Then why are you so practiced at it?"

"Fine..." Li Luo sighed. "Back in middle school, Zhao Rongjun got curious and dragged me along to drink a few times."

"How could he do that?" Ying Chanxi frowned, a little displeased. "He even corrupted you."

"You can't really put it that way." Li Luo felt a bit embarrassed, silently chanting "my bad, my bad" in his heart. "A little alcohol is fine for the mood, as long as you don't drink often. Binge drinking is definitely not okay, but having a couple of drinks when the atmosphere is right is harmless."

"Exactly, exactly." Xu Youyu wrapped an arm around Ying Chanxi's neck and helped her open her beer. "Come on, cheers!"

Ying Chanxi dazedly took the beer. After clinking cans with Xu Youyu and Li Luo, she held the can with both hands and took a tiny sip.

Then her brows furrowed slightly.

"How is it?" Li Luo asked. "If you don't like it, don't drink anymore."

"It's a bit hard to describe." Ying Chanxi savored the liquid in her mouth. "It just tastes weird."

"It's your first time, just have a small taste." Li Luo helped her put the beer can on the coffee table, then started shuffling the cards. "Come on, let's play."

"Play cards, play cards!" After drinking, Xu Youyu was clearly more energetic. She crossed her legs on the sofa, swayed her body, and then pulled a tube of lipstick out of her pocket. "Almost forgot this."

"What are you doing?" Li Luo was just about to deal the cards when he saw her take out such a thing and asked with a wary look on his face.

"A forfeit, of course." Xu Youyu chuckled. "What's the fun without some stakes? The loser has to let the others draw on their face with lipstick."

"Damn! We're playing for such high stakes?"

"What's the big deal? Hurry up and deal! You're not scared, are you?"

"What's there for me to be scared of?"

"What about Chanxi?"

"I-I... bring it on, I'm not scared either."

The lipstick was placed in the center of the coffee table.

After dealing, Li Luo arranged his hand, then closed his eyes for a moment, a faint glimmer flashing through them.

The corners of his mouth curled up slightly.

He thought to himself.

Senior, you're the one who walked right into the line of fire.

Don't blame me for being ruthless!

Li Luo opened his eyes, a sharp glint in them.

In his mind—

Memory Palace.

Full activation!

(End of this chapter)
